description: Run on persistent databases with an artificial 10ms delay on each WAL fsync, emulating high-latency durable storage under group commit. Deliberately NOT in the Makefile's TEST_CONFIGS: a 10ms delay per fsync makes a full suite run impractical for per-PR CI. Intended for targeted manual stress runs, e.g. test/unittest --test-config test/configs/wal_fsync_delay.json 'test/sql/parallelism/interquery/*'
